title: Hyland Orchard & Pavilion

services.name: weddings & Private Rentals
services.desc: We offer a welcome, relaxed and beautifully natural atmosphere. We are located in the quaint village of Fiskdale in Sturbridge, Massachusetts. We are a one-of-a-kind venue offering a unique outdoor setting for an Orchard wedding. The Ceremony area sits atop the Orchard and the Reception takes place in the Pavilion (with sliding walls). The Hyland Orchard Wedding may be purchased in basic form, for a more DIY wedding experience, or become more of a full-service experience by hiring Design by Doe for Coordination, florals and decor rentals. Whether you decide to handle all your details, or bring on DbD, Hyland Orchard is a magical spot for an epic Orchard wedding! We offer a private Pavilion
